name: fatami-ali-pharmaceuticals
description: Corporate website for Fatami Ali Pharmaceuticals — pharmaceuticals, medical equipment and healthcare solutions, Kabul, Afghanistan.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/rebase-assets.mjs && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.build:standalone: cross-env STANDALONE=1 VITE_HASH_ROUTER=1 vite build && node scripts/standalone.mjs
scripts.build:pages: cross-env VITE_HASH_ROUTER=1 vite build && node scripts/rebase-assets.mjs && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
